digest.en: US President Trump threatens Iran with "higher level" bombing if it doesn't reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Tehran is reviewing a US proposal even as Trump issues an ultimatum for Iran to accept a deal or face more bombing. Oil prices drop after reports of a potential deal.

articles.title: UN demands Israel immediately releases flotilla activists

articles.title: Abdellatif Hammouchi Leads Security Delegation to Vienna for UN Meeting

articles.title: Iran is now a superpower; ties with India are flourishing: Iran Foreign Ministry spokesperson
articles.summary: Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesperson, Mr. Baqaei, stated that Iran's ties with India are flourishing. He also mentioned that Tehran is reviewing America's response to its peace proposal. The proposal aims to improve relations between Iran and the US.

articles.title: CNN founder Ted Turner, a brash and outspoken television pioneer, has died at age 87
articles.summary: Ted Turner, the founder of CNN and a television pioneer, has died at the age of 87. He transformed an Atlanta TV station into a satellite-based "superstation" and founded the first 24-hour news network, CNN. Turner was known for his outspoken personality.

articles.title: Four killed in post-election violence in India’s West Bengal
articles.summary: Four people were killed in post-election violence in India's West Bengal, where the ruling BJP won the state election for the first time. The unrest has gripped the key eastern state, with reports of clashes between supporters and opponents.

articles.title: Greetings from a sea village in Indonesia, where Indigenous fishing gets help from mangroves
